title: Cloudflare Workers API – Delayed or Inconsistent Responses

updates.body:
Cloudflare is investigating an issue affecting the Workers API and Workers configuration in the Cloudflare dashboard. 
Customers may see out-of-date or inconsistent information when viewing or managing Workers. 
For example, recent deployments or configuration changes may not show up right away. 
Workers that are already running in production are not affected. 


We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
Multiple fixes are underway to address the underlying problem.
Fixes have been deployed to production and inconsistent reads no longer appear to occurring. Continuing to monitor throughout the remainder of the day.
This incident has been resolved.

updates.body:
Cloudflare is currently investigating issues related to Magic Transit. A subset of Magic Transit customers have a Cloudflare-managed setting enabled that clears the Don't Fragment (DF) flag. For these customers, the setting is not currently taking effect. As a result, packets with the DF flag set and larger than the tunnel MTU may be dropped.
We advise customers to set an MSS clamp on their egress traffic in order to ensure ingress traffic is correctly sized.
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
This incident has been resolved.
